summary: DNA X, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its ChEF Purchase Agreement and related Registration Rights Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC, effective May 28, 2026. The original September 2025 agreement committed Chardan to purchase up to $500 million of DNA X common stock, subject to conditions. No termination fee or penalty is disclosed. The termination removes a key equity financing facility, potentially affecting liquidity. Investors should monitor for alternative financing arrangements or operational adjustments.
